limitations: The forced five-conic type is necessary only, not realized by a constructed arrangement; results are limited to smooth conics with the listed singularities, no ordinary triple points. The four-conic example and general six-conic ceiling are prior work.
scientific_integrity: The corrected theorem is the triple-free five-conic necessary basket and K2,3 contact-graph structure; the general six-conic ceiling and four-conic witness are established earlier and expressly attributed.
title: Triple-free boundary rigidity in nearly free smooth-conic arrangements
